pages.title: Bertanya & Menjawab
pages.intro: Untuk **bertanya** apa yang dipakai seseorang, pakai kata **What** dan **wearing**.

blocks.title: Bertanya: What ... wearing?
blocks.ex:
What are you wearing?
What is she wearing?
blocks.exId:
(Kamu sedang memakai apa?)
(Dia perempuan sedang memakai apa?)

blocks.title: Menjawab
blocks.ex: I am wearing a red cap.

blocks.title: Pertanyaan Ya / Tidak
blocks.ex:
Is he wearing a hat?
Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

pages.title: Cara Memakai TO BE (Is, Am, Are)
pages.intro: Dalam Bahasa Inggris, saat mau bilang **"sedang memakai"**, gunakan **To Be** (am / is / are) sebelum kata **wearing**.

blocks.title: 3. Gunakan "ARE"
blocks.text: Untuk **banyak orang** (You, We, They, Adara & Olivia).

lines.en: Adara and Olivia are going to school.
lines.id: Adara dan Olivia pergi ke sekolah.

lines.en: Adara is wearing a pink dress and white shoes.
lines.id: Adara memakai gaun merah muda dan sepatu putih.

lines.en: Olivia is wearing a blue shirt and a black skirt.
lines.id: Olivia memakai kemeja biru dan rok hitam.

lines.en: It is hot, so Adara is not wearing a jacket.
lines.id: Cuaca panas, jadi Adara tidak memakai jaket.

lines.en: Adara: What are you wearing today, Olivia?
lines.id: Adara: Kamu memakai apa hari ini, Olivia?

lines.en: Olivia: I am wearing a blue shirt and a black skirt.
lines.id: Olivia: Aku memakai kemeja biru dan rok hitam.

lines.en: Adara: Is Budi wearing a cap?
lines.id: Adara: Apakah Budi memakai topi bisbol?

lines.en: Olivia: Yes, he is. He is wearing a red cap.
lines.id: Olivia: Ya. Dia memakai topi bisbol merah.

lines.en: Olivia: No, they aren't. It is hot today.

quiz.q: What do you wear on your head when riding a motorcycle?
quiz.explain: Helmet = helm, dipakai di kepala saat naik motor.
Hat = topi.
Shoes = sepatu, dipakai di kaki.
Subjek I selalu memakai am.
She = 1 orang, jadi pakai is.
They = banyak orang, jadi pakai are.
Shorts = celana pendek. Pants = celana panjang.

quiz.q: What keeps your neck warm in cold weather?
quiz.explain: Scarf = syal, menghangatkan leher.

quiz.q: In the story, what are Adara and Olivia wearing on their heads?
quiz.explain: Di cerita: "They are wearing red caps."

quiz.q: What do you wear to see better?
quiz.explain: Glasses = kacamata.

quiz.q: What color is Adara's dress in the story?
quiz.explain: Adara is wearing a pink dress.

quiz.q: "Dia sedang memakai sepatu bot." = He is wearing ___.
quiz.explain: Boots = sepatu bot.
He = 1 orang, jadi He is wearing.

quiz.q: What do you wear on your hands in winter?
quiz.explain: Gloves = sarung tangan.
Socks = kaus kaki.
Susunan benar: What are you wearing?

quiz.hint: Olivia dan I = 2 orang. Itu termasuk banyak orang.
quiz.explain: Olivia and I = we (banyak orang), jadi pakai are.

quiz.hint: Jawaban Yes/No memakai kata to be yang sama dengan pertanyaannya.
quiz.explain: Pertanyaannya memakai Is, jadi jawab Yes, she is.

quiz.hint: Cari kalimat yang banyak orang tetapi memakai is.
quiz.explain: They harus dengan are: They are wearing jackets.

quiz.q: Arrange the words: wearing / is / a / jacket / Budi / brown
options: Budi wearing is a brown jacket.
Budi is wearing a brown jacket.
Is Budi wearing brown a jacket.
Budi is a wearing brown jacket.
quiz.hint: Susunan: orang + is + wearing + a + warna + pakaian.
quiz.explain: Budi is wearing a brown jacket.
